Name: Wildflour's Four Seasons Farm Map
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/nfUW6xU.png[/img][/size][/font][size=3]

A special farm map that starts out with just one small area. Unlock FOUR additional farm spaces, each themed to a specific season, with custom bundles!

Notes: This is a CUSTOM farm map; it does not replace any existing map.

Unlock Requirements: There are four bundles in the corners of the map; interact with them to see how to unlock each space.

[font=Georgia][font=Georgia][img]https://i.imgur.com/RHabloO.png[/img][/font][/font]
[font=Georgia][font=Georgia]

Thanks to Lumisteria for her gorgeous tilesheets as well.

Thanks to all my friends who listen to me scope creep myself into these mod ideas.
